title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1988-09-03
lineage: Playback of MCs on recording deck (Marantz PMDxxx) > Sony D6 > Maxell XL90s (1st gen). 1st (gen) > Playback on Marantz PRD505 (azimuth adjusted) > Marantz Intergrated Stereo Amp MP-68 > SB Audigy4 on new P4 machine > Sound Forge normalization > WAV > CDWave > WAVs > Flacfrontend 1.7.1 (level 8) > flacs.

ai_review.summary: Electric Ripple steals the night even though the source is only fair and uneven.
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for an electric rendition of “Ripple” that had fans ecstatic, with Jerry’s guitar described as flawless and the band delivering a classic ’88 performance. Recording quality, however, is divided – one listener calls it the poorest source on the Archive while another finds it still listenable, leaving the technical side at best fair.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (especially Ripple and overall band energy) pushes the rating up, but multiple complaints about a low‑quality source pull it down; the blend yields a solid mid‑high score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer labels it the poorest source on the Archive, while another claims any source is listenable if you have the right mindset; no concrete soundboard/audience details are given.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewed as a classic ’88 set that “does not let you down,” with the band maintaining high energy throughout and the electric Ripple serving as a memorable highlight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as not missing a note or verse during the electric Ripple; praised for flawless guitar work.
